accepted.reliability: high for year; quarter deliberately omitted
accepted.decision: The developer states that Rail.A will open in 2026, and the current IBC listing independently gives 2026. IBC's Q3 is not copied because construction updates and older plans do not support quarter-level precision.

accepted.reliability: high for year; quarter deliberately omitted

The current official developer page explicitly publishes GBA/GLA 77,315/57,924 sqm for the same Prime-class office building at Leningradsky Prospekt 36 building 13. The earlier rounded GLA 56,000 is replaced by the official exact value.
